stem.text: Let \( W(t) = t + 9 \arctan{\left(t \right)} \) for \( 0 \le t \le 7 \). Using a calculator, find the value of t in the interval \( 1 < t < 4 \) at which the instantaneous rate of change of W equals the average rate of change of W over \( 1 \le t \le 4 \). Show the setup for the calculation, and give the value correct to three decimal places.

worked_solution.text: The average rate of change of W over the interval is \( \frac{W(4) - W(1)}{4 - 1} \), which is about 2.621 (more places are kept).
Differentiate: \( W'(t) = 1 + \frac{9}{t^{2} + 1} \). Set \( W'(t) \) equal to the average rate of change and solve on \( 1 < t < 4 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: instantaneous rate set equal to the average rate

worked_solution.text: The calculator's solver gives one solution in the interval, \( t = 2.133 \).

options.derivation: W at both endpoints rounded to whole numbers before forming the average rate of change
the average rate of change rounded to one decimal place before solving
the average rate of change taken over 0 to 4 instead of the stated interval, then solved on that wider interval
